id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1358: "But if true, it's scary. We should think of measures against the witch's revival.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1376: "I hear the king himself will now set out to hunt the Darkspawn. I hope nothing dangerous happens.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|138a: "I saw her, the witch Lizzlette. I knew her from legend, but up close she's really beautiful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1397: "Looked at by those lovely eyes, I wouldn't mind being frozen.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d7: "Looks like Lizzlette had nothing to do with whoever spread the Gold Plague. I feel bad for her.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e9: "I heard, I heard. In the end, Charlotte's decision to stay neutral on the Darkspawn was right.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f7: "She's a wise queen to match her predecessor. I hope her reign lasts forever.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|141e: "I'm childhood friends with the queen, Charlotte. We grew up like sisters from small.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|142b: "In this castle, I'm certainly the one who understands Charlotte best.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1439: "The recently appeared ice witch befriended shy Charlotte in just a few days.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1445: "Even I, her childhood friend, took years to get close... Now I've lost my place!

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1460: "That's why seeing Charlotte struggling alone makes me frustrated that I can do nothing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1470: "It's this time already. One of my coworkers should be coming to the castle soon.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1479: "She's already a grandma, yet she doesn't take days off even now. Her dedication is admirable.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1489: "My coworker at the castle never shows up, no matter how long I wait.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1492: "She's a dedicated grandma and this never happened before. I'm worried. Did something happen...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14a0: "Those turned gold by the plague are back safe, and Charlotte is well again! It's thanks to you, thank you so much!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14b3: "Charlotte is shy, and even I, who grew up with her, took years to get close.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c0: "But the ice witch befriended her at once and is now treated as a trusted advisor!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14cc: "If things had gone smoothly, I'd have become her aide! Now my plan is ruined!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f2: "You're the guest the queen invited. She awaits you in the throne room deep in the castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1505: "This is Sniflheim Castle, ruled by the beautiful queen Charlotte.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|151e: "This is Sniflheim Castle, ruled by the beautiful queen Charlotte.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|150d: "Said to be the most beautiful of castles worldwide, Sniflheim Castle. Please take a tour.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1525: "Now known as the castle where a beautiful witch lives, please take your time touring it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1535: "This is Sniflheim Castle. When the world was at peace, it was a renowned castle for its beauty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1554: "This is Sniflheim Castle. When the world was at peace, it was a renowned castle for its beauty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1542: "But now a strange illness has spread, and that's no longer the case. Please be careful not to catch it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1560: "The dreaded Gold Plague has vanished. Will the day come when Sniflheim Castle is lively again?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1572: "This is Sniflheim Castle. The Gold Plague is gone, a beautiful, famed castle at peace again.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|157e: "The liveliness of peaceful days will surely return someday.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1589: "{var:1}, Queen Charlotte seems troubled, but we soldiers would be presumptuous to ask.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1596: "But you, her benefactor, could surely be someone to confide in. Would you hear her out?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15ad: "With Snaerfelt's black dragon slain, the castle has regained its old quiet. Enjoy this beautiful castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15d5: "This castle's sturdy stone shuts out the outside cold, so it stays warm, but...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e0: "Today the inside feels colder than usual. The outside isn't that bad, strangely.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15ef: "The castle was cold but finally seems warm. The fireplace must be working.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15fd: "The other day Lizzlette showed me ice magic.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1604: "She froze a flower instantly, and when she squeezed it, it shattered. Like a magic trick.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1615: "Our queen Charlotte is in the throne room beyond this.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|161e: "She is pained by the terrible disaster striking this land. Please lend her your strength...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1630: "Charlotte told me. You'll lend us strength against the terrible disaster, the Gold Plague.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|163d: "Thank you, {var:1}. Now the townspeople will open their doors and cooperate.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|164f: "I heard from the messenger. Eerie gold monsters attacked the town and you drove them off.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|165d: "The monsters looked like soldiers and were well organized... Is there a boss somewhere?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|166c: "Thanks to {var:1}'s efforts, the terror of the Gold Plague is over. Charlotte was delighted too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|167a: "Ugh... the wound from that dread dragon aches. We can't beat it however we try. I wish someone would defeat that dragon...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|168b: "Ugh... the wound from that dread dragon aches. But as a Sniflheim soldier, I can't whine over this.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1697: "I'll treat this wound as a reminder and train even harder.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16b7: "Charlotte is serious, but a bit sloppy in private.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16bf: "She's especially bad at cleaning, and it gets messy fast unless I do it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16cc: "Since befriending the witch, Charlotte's expression seems livelier.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d5: "I'm so glad she has a good friend. She often moped alone after her father, the late king, died.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e9: "The mysterious illness spreading through the country... the witch was suspected of causing it and locked up.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f6: "Charlotte believed in the witch to the end, but to calm the people's anxiety, she had no choice...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1723: "Charlotte believed in the witch to the end, but to calm the people's anxiety, she had no choice...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1703: "Charlotte and the witch had just become good friends, and it's truly a shame this happened.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1730: "Charlotte and the witch had just become good friends, and it's truly a shame this happened.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1716: "The Gold Plague spreading through the country... the witch was suspected of causing it and locked up.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1740: "The witch's innocence was proven and she was released from the cell. Charlotte was delighted too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|174c: "I'm glad Charlotte and the witch's friendship didn't crack.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1759: "The queen seems busy lately, and her room is messier than usual.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1761: "But I'll clean it. Our job as maids is to let the queen focus on governing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1788: "If the queen invited you, head to the throne room deep in the castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1794: "Beyond is an elevator to the basement. I won't stop you if you're curious, but there's only a prison down there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17a4: "There's an elevator to the basement ahead, but only a prison is down there. I doubt there's much point going.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17b7: "The elevator ahead was built with ancient technology lost long ago, powered by magic, they say.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17c6: "To move something so huge, the old folks' technology was amazing.

tm.「城の中が 冷えてたけど\n やっと あたたまってきたみたいだ。\n だんろの火: "The castle was cold but finally seems warm. The fireplace must be working.
tm.「この前 リーズレットさんに\n 氷の魔法を 見せてもらったよ。: "The other day Lizzlette showed me ice magic.
tm.「花を一瞬で凍らせて 手で握ると\n 花が 粉々に砕けちってさ。\n まるで 手: "She froze a flower instantly, and when she squeezed it, it shattered. Like a magic trick.
tm.「我らが女王 シャールさまは\n この奥の 玉座の間に いらっしゃいます。: "Our queen Charlotte is in the throne room beyond this.
tm.「昨今 この地をみまう おそるべき災厄に\n シャールさまは 心を痛めておいでで: "She is pained by the terrible disaster striking this land. Please lend her your strength...
tm.「シャールさまから お聞きしました。\n 黄金病という おそるべき災厄に対し\n: "Charlotte told me. You'll lend us strength against the terrible disaster, the Gold Plague.
tm.「ありがとうございます {var:1}さん。\n 今ならば 町に住む人々も 門戸: "Thank you, {var:1}. Now the townspeople will open their doors and cooperate.
tm.「伝令から聞いております。\n 城下町が 不気味な 黄金の魔物に襲われ\n {v: "I heard from the messenger. Eerie gold monsters attacked the town and you drove them off.
tm.「魔物たちは 兵士のような姿をしていて\n 統率が とれていたそうですね……。\: "The monsters looked like soldiers and were well organized... Is there a boss somewhere?
tm.「{var:1}さんたちの ご活躍により\n 黄金病の恐怖は 終わりました。\n: "Thanks to {var:1}'s efforts, the terror of the Gold Plague is over. Charlotte was delighted too.
tm.「うう……あの魔竜に やられたキズが痛むよ。\n オレたちじゃ どうやっても か: "Ugh... the wound from that dread dragon aches. We can't beat it however we try. I wish someone would defeat that dragon...
tm.「うう……あの魔竜に やられたキズが痛むよ。\n でも クレイモランの兵士たる者: "Ugh... the wound from that dread dragon aches. But as a Sniflheim soldier, I can't whine over this.
tm.「このキズを 自分へのいましめとして\n さらなる訓練に はげむとするよ。: "I'll treat this wound as a reminder and train even harder.
tm.「シャールさまは マジメな性格だけど\n 私生活は けっこう ズボラなところがあ: "Charlotte is serious, but a bit sloppy in private.
tm.「特に 掃除は苦手で\n あたしが してあげないと\n すぐに 散らかっちゃうの: "She's especially bad at cleaning, and it gets messy fast unless I do it.
tm.「シャールさま 魔女さんと友達になってから\n 表情が イキイキしてるように見え: "Since befriending the witch, Charlotte's expression seems livelier.
tm.「いい友達ができて 本当に よかったわ。\n 先王である お父上が亡くなって\n: "I'm so glad she has a good friend. She often moped alone after her father, the late king, died.
tm.「この国で蔓延している 謎の奇病。\n その原因の容疑を かけられ\n 魔女さん: "The mysterious illness spreading through the country... the witch was suspected of causing it and locked up.
tm.「シャールさまは 最後まで\n 魔女さんを 信じていたようだったけど\n 国民た: "Charlotte believed in the witch to the end, but to calm the people's anxiety, she had no choice...
tm.「シャールさまと 魔女さん……。\n せっかく 仲のよい お友達になられたのに\: "Charlotte and the witch had just become good friends, and it's truly a shame this happened.
tm.「この国で蔓延している 黄金病……。\n その原因の容疑を かけられ\n 魔女さ: "The Gold Plague spreading through the country... the witch was suspected of causing it and locked up.
tm.「魔女さんの無実が 証明されて\n さっそく 牢屋からも解放されたそうよ。\n: "The witch's innocence was proven and she was released from the cell. Charlotte was delighted too.
tm.「シャールさまと魔女さんの ふたりの友情に\n ヒビが入らなくて よかったわ。: "I'm glad Charlotte and the witch's friendship didn't crack.
tm.「女王さま このところ 忙しいみたいで\n 部屋が いつもより 散らかってるわ。: "The queen seems busy lately, and her room is messier than usual.
tm.「でも 私が掃除するから いいの。\n 女王さまが 政務に集中できるようにするの: "But I'll clean it. Our job as maids is to let the queen focus on governing.
tm.「女王さまに 招かれているなら\n 城の奥にある 玉座の間に 向かうといい。: "If the queen invited you, head to the throne room deep in the castle.
tm.「この先は 地下につながる 昇降機だ。\n 興味があるなら 止めないが\n 地下: "Beyond is an elevator to the basement. I won't stop you if you're curious, but there's only a prison down there.
tm.「この先には 地下につながる 昇降機があるが\n 地下には 牢獄くらいしかないか: "There's an elevator to the basement ahead, but only a prison is down there. I doubt there's much point going.
tm.「この先にある昇降機は ずいぶん前に失われた\n 古代の技術で 作られたもので\: "The elevator ahead was built with ancient technology lost long ago, powered by magic, they say.
tm.「あんなに 大きなモノを 動かすなんて\n 昔の人の技術は すごかったんだな。: "To move something so huge, the old folks' technology was amazing.
